highlights_headline: This unreleased 4.151.0 work adds the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel reads, and two native memory-leak fixes.
highlights_body: Graphite bindings bring hardware-accelerated Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn support under a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package. Two native use-after-free leaks are closed, and async RequestReadPixels lands on SKImage and SKSurface.

bullets.lead: Graphite GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn
bullets.detail: New bindings expose the Skia Graphite next-generation GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, shipped as a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with cross-platform test coverage on Android and Linux.

bullets.lead: Backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels on SKImage and SKSurface
bullets.detail: A new async RequestReadPixels API lets callers read back rendered pixels from any GPU backend without blocking the render thread.

bullets.lead: FreeType font support on Nano Server
bullets.detail: Uses FreeType for font rendering on Windows Nano Server, which has no GDI font stack, enabling text rendering in containerized server workloads.
The underlying SKRegion was being collected while the iterator still held a native pointer; the region is now kept alive for the iterator's lifetime.

bullets.lead: Pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path closed
bullets.detail: When SKImage.Create failed after allocating a CoTaskMem pixel buffer, the buffer was leaked; it is now freed on the failure path.

bullets.lead: Native use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* fixed
bullets.detail: The parent pixel source was not kept alive across ExtractSubset and the With* family of SKPixmap methods, causing intermittent native crashes.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Windows Nano Server.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Improved Windows native build setup by initializing the MSVC environment once per build.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Graphite GPU backend bindings, Uno and sample infrastructure work.
